name: list-constructor-spread-operator-test-ae223889d2/inference-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported
Subset restrictions > Import declarations: ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: value:cloneWithType; value:fromJsonWithType; value:toString and value:toBalString
reason: List constructors are supported, but the readonly spread assertions depend on actualArr.ensureType(AnyArr). The lang.value ensureType function is absent from both the supported langlib methods and the method-call whitelist, so the complete case requires unsupported behavior.
test_design_notes: The case asserts spread inference and element values for fixed arrays, variable-length arrays, tuples, readonly lists, typedesc targets and never rest descriptors.
The io:println reference in main is instrumentation and does not determine classification.
